en: Colorized historic postcard view of a small industrial area by a stream or millrace. Several multi‑story masonry and wooden buildings stand around a small waterfall and dam, with leafless trees in the foreground and a few people on a footbridge or walkway near the water. The scene has a rural Nordic feel. Red printed text at the top left reads "Stampen, Karlshamn." and a smaller text underneath indicates the photographer or publisher.
